## 这是fire数据的处理流程（主程序部分）

首先进入pypeit环境，python3.11
```bash
source /home/yin/github_item/presto/presto_envronment.sh
# 根据自己操作系统需要
```
然后进入项目目录，在该目录下准备好科学星文件和模版星文件
```bash
cd /mnt/disk1/myresource/fire_reduction
```
在该文件夹下执行
```bash
pypeit_setup -s magellan_fire_long -r raw_data_2026may31 -c all
```
其中`magellan_fire_long`是在官网查的仪器名称，`raw_data_2026may31`是原始数据所在的文件夹。
我们编辑文件`./magellan_fire_long_A/magellan_fire_long_A.pypeit`

为了实现A1-B1，B1-A1，A2-B2，B2-A2四个数据，我们编辑该文件：

>其中
>①# Data block 的path要指向RAWDIR的绝对路径
>②对我们而言，fire78，fire87的framtype改为arc,tilt；fire74-77改为science
>③对于ABBA模式我们如图将目标星和标准星配置参数,其他条目calib 为all
>④确保每一行的竖线对齐即可 仪器改为spectrograph = magellan_fire_long

然后
```bash
cd magellan_fire_long_A
run_pypeit magellan_fire_long_A.pypeit
```
我们等待十几分钟后就可以去`/magellan_fire_long_A/Science/`文件夹下拿结果了



## 这是fire数据的处理流程（主程序之后的部分）

首先进入pypeit环境，python3.11
```bash
source /home/yin/github_item/presto/presto_envronment.sh
# 根据自己操作系统需要
```
然后进入项目目录，在该目录下准备好科学星文件和模版星文件
```bash
ls

处理流程.md
spec1d_fire_0074-COCONUTS-2A_FIRE_85970523T110233.000.fits
spec1d_fire_0074-COCONUTS-2A_FIRE_85970523T110233.000.txt
spec1d_fire_0075-COCONUTS-2A_FIRE_85970523T110607.000.fits
spec1d_fire_0075-COCONUTS-2A_FIRE_85970523T110607.000.txt
spec1d_fire_0079-HD62139_FIRE_85970523T112011.000.fits

```
### sense_function部分
首先创建```sensfunc_Jband.inp```文件,然后编辑
```bash
touch sensfunc_Jband.inp
```
在该文件下添加内容
```json
[sensfunc]
    algorithm = IR
    star_mag = 10.03
    star_type = PHOENIX
#   flatfile = /mnt/disk1/myresource/fire_reduction/magellan_fire_A/Calibrations/Flat_A_all_DET01.fits
    [[IR]]
        telgridfile = 'TellPCA_3000_26000_R10000.fits'
```

然后执行
```bash
pypeit_sensfunc spec1d_fire_0079-HD62139_FIRE_85970523T112011.000.fits  -s sensfunc_Jband.inp -o ./sensfunc2.fits
```
我们就得到了```./sensfunc.fits```文件

### Fluxing部分
直接执行
```bash
pypeit_flux_setup /mnt/disk1/myresource/fire_reduction/magellan_fire_A/Science
#这个目录是之前主程序的Science目录
```
会生成
```
magellan_fire_long.coadd1d
magellan_fire_long.flux
magellan_fire_long.tell
```
三个文件，我们先编辑```magellan_fire_long.flux```文件，
把它变成
```bash
# Auto-generated Flux input file using PypeIt version: 2.0.1
# UTC 2026-08-26T13:35:25.717+00:00

# User-defined execution parameters
[fluxcalib]
  extinct_correct = False  # Set to True if your SENSFUNC derived with the UVIS algorithm
# Please add your SENSFUNC file name below before running pypeit_flux_calib

# Data block 
flux read
 path .
                                                  filename | sensfile
spec1d_fire_0074-COCONUTS-2A_FIRE_85970523T110233.000.fits | sensfunc.fits
spec1d_fire_0075-COCONUTS-2A_FIRE_85970523T110607.000.fits |
flux end
```
然后执行```pypeit_flux_calib magellan_fire_long.flux```  
注意，这一步会直接写入源文件

### Coadd 1D部分
编辑```magellan_fire_long.coadd1d```文件：
```bash
# Auto-generated Coadd1D input file using PypeIt version: 2.0.1
# UTC 2026-08-26T13:35:25.727+00:00

# User-defined execution parameters
[coadd1d]
  coaddfile = 'coconuts2a_coadd.fits'  # Please set your output file name
  wave_method = linear  # creates a uniformly space grid in lambda
# This file includes all extracted objects. You need to figure out which object you want to 
# coadd before running pypeit_coadd_1dspec!!!

# Data block 
coadd1d read
 path .
                                                  filename |                  obj_id
spec1d_fire_0074-COCONUTS-2A_FIRE_85970523T110233.000.fits | SPAT0164-SLIT0176-DET01
spec1d_fire_0075-COCONUTS-2A_FIRE_85970523T110607.000.fits | SPAT0224-SLIT0176-DET01
coadd1d end
```

然后```pypeit_coadd_1dspec magellan_fire_long.coadd1d```  ,我们就可以得到```coconuts2a_coadd.fits```文件

### Telluric Correction部分
我们编辑```magellan_fire_long.tell```
```bash
# Auto-generated Telluric input file using PypeIt version: 2.0.1
# UTC 2026-08-26T13:35:25.728+00:00

# User-defined execution parameters
[telluric]
    objmodel = poly
    polyorder = 3
    fit_wv_min_max = 8000, 27000
```
然后执行```pypeit_tellfit  coconuts2a_coadd.fits -t magellan_fire_long.tell```

就可以得到```coconuts2a_coadd_tellcorr.fits```文件了
